description: ADTS at a core rate of 22050 Hz with channel configuration 3 (a single channel element and a channel pair element), each followed by SBR data, and the single channel element's carrying the parametric stereo extension's ID: decoders apply parametric stereo to a core of one channel only, so the stream is HE-AAC with three channels and the ID is reported.
findings: ADTS cannot signal SBR or PS explicitly, but 12 of 12 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC,
12 of 12 raw data blocks carry the parametric stereo extension's ID, but the core has 3 channels

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
